_doc: T-273 Totenhafen's round 1 opening, 'the night shift runs' (gravelight/world/inn_opening/inn_opening.gd: Map 0's machinery, map00_opening.json's _doc explains every key). Three of the cannery's night shift are on the far side of its side door onto the quay (gen_map02 SIDE_DOOR_Z: the cannery's east wall, x 0, z 1.8..3.4) when the squad arrives; before round 1 they are heard through the door, talking about the cold and the singing out by the pens (the intro lines; the look gate waits for the player to face the door, at most look.max_seconds). The pounding at the windows and the door is the cue; round 1 starts. Boldt, the foreman, unbars the side door and holds it; Tews and Rahn run out onto the quay for the sea stairs at the parapet's west end. Two of the dead rise on the quay by the stairs' head (the attackers): one catches Rahn two steps out of the door, the other Boldt as he comes out last; both fall and rise as dockworkers a few seconds later, in the squad's own zone. Tews gets down the stairs and away west along the beach under the cannery's wall (escape: she fades beyond fade_distance). The doorway stays filled with an invisible collider for good (CannerySideDoorBlock): the patrons have no colliders and pass, nobody else ever does, so the cannery's 1000 door is never skipped; the leaf swings shut behind them (close_at) and is never barred again (bar_at past end_by: nobody is left inside to drop the bar). Round accounting as Map 0's: the risers' and the attackers' slots are taken off round 1's queue (4 of solo's 8). front_door.face_door: a patron working the door faces the door itself (the default faces north, Map 0's front door). No title card: Map 2 is never a campaign's first map, and a campaign arrival cancels the opening. No flare (no hearth on a quay). Positions: map space; the patrons' paths ignore colliders (they have none) and stay on the cannery's floor, the quay and the shingle (y -0.1).
